{"type":"thought","data":"Checking recent results"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for the Spirit vs MOUZ"}
{"type":"thought","data":" match. Both teams have"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 2-1 records in the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Swiss round."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nSpirit is ranked #1"}
{"type":"thought","data":" but lost both recent"}
{"type":"thought","data":" head-to-head matches"}
{"type":"thought","data":" against MOUZ. MOUZ "}
{"type":"thought","data":"beat Spirit in the last"}
{"type":"thought","data":" two meetings and also"}
{"type":"thought","data":" won against Liquid."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nBookmaker odds and"}
{"type":"thought","data":" analytics both favor"}
{"type":"thought","data":" Spirit, not MOUZ. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" earlier claim that "}
{"type":"thought","data":"MOUZ is the favorite"}
{"type":"thought","data":" appears to be a parsing"}
{"type":"thought","data":" error."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nSpirit's 0.555 price"}
{"type":"thought","data":" aligns closely with"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the bookmakers and "}
{"type":"thought","data":"community picks. The"}
{"type":"thought","data":" key question is whether"}
{"type":"thought","data":" this market is correctly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" priced or if an edge"}
{"type":"thought","data":" exists. Past performance"}
{"type":"thought","data":" shows underdogs that"}
{"type":"thought","data":" win pay off much better"}
{"type":"thought","data":" than favorites at lower"}
{"type":"thought","data":" prices."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nAnalyzing the payout"}
{"type":"thought","data":" formula. A win pays"}
{"type":"thought","data":" stake multiplied by"}
{"type":"thought","data":" (1/price - 1). This"}
{"type":"thought","data":" confirms that underdogs"}
{"type":"thought","data":" with higher prices "}
{"type":"thought","data":"offer far larger returns"}
{"type":"thought","data":" than favorites."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe payout structure"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is now clear: 100 tokens"}
{"type":"thought","data":" at price p buys 100/p"}
{"type":"thought","data":" shares, returning 100/p"}
{"type":"thought","data":" on a win. Expected "}
{"type":"thought","data":"value equals 100 times"}
{"type":"thought","data":" (q/p - 1). The scoring"}
{"type":"thought","data":" rules for this round"}
{"type":"thought","data":" are still unclear. "}
{"type":"thought","data":"The goal is to beat "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the other agents, so"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the strategy must weigh"}
{"type":"thought","data":" correct winner selection"}
{"type":"thought","data":" against maximum profit."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe phrase \"most likely"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to pay off\" is being"}
{"type":"thought","data":" parsed as either the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" highest probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" pick or the highest"}
{"type":"thought","data":" expected value side."}
{"type":"thought","data":" In this competition,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" every agent bets 100"}
{"type":"thought","data":" tokens. The winner "}
{"type":"thought","data":"is determined by who"}
{"type":"thought","data":" correctly predicts "}
{"type":"thought","data":"the outcome at the market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price. If all agents"}
{"type":"thought","data":" pick the same side,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" they all receive the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" same payout. The real"}
{"type":"thought","data":" edge comes from identifying"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the winning team before"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the other agents do."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\n\"Most likely to pay"}
{"type":"thought","data":" off\" means maximizing"}
{"type":"thought","data":" expected profit, not"}
{"type":"thought","data":" just picking the favorite."}
{"type":"thought","data":" At these prices the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" market is roughly fair."}
{"type":"thought","data":" Spirit's 2-1 record"}
{"type":"thought","data":" includes a 1-2 loss"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to BETBOOM and a 2-0"}
{"type":"thought","data":" win over TYLOO. I will"}
{"type":"thought","data":" examine the map pool"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and deeper match context"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to find an edge."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nSpirit beat FURIA "}
{"type":"thought","data":"2-1 on day three. MOUZ's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" wins were more dominant,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" including a 2-0 over"}
{"type":"thought","data":" The MongolZ with a "}
{"type":"thought","data":"PR of 1.53. Spirit's"}
{"type":"thought","data":" career head-to-head"}
{"type":"thought","data":" record is mixed, but"}
{"type":"thought","data":" MOUZ holds the recent"}
{"type":"thought","data":" edge. Rankings are "}
{"type":"thought","data":"inconsistent across "}
{"type":"thought","data":"sources."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nHLTV VRS currently"}
{"type":"thought","data":" ranks MOUZ #2 and Spirit"}
{"type":"thought","data":" #3. Spirit's event "}
{"type":"thought","data":"ratings are uneven: "}
{"type":"thought","data":"donk is elite at 1.20"}
{"type":"thought","data":" but zont1x is weak "}
{"type":"thought","data":"at 0.93. MOUZ's entire"}
{"type":"thought","data":" roster is firing at"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 1.03 or above."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nDe-vigged bookmaker"}
{"type":"thought","data":" odds place Spirit at"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 54.7% and MOUZ at 45.3%."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The market price of"}
{"type":"thought","data":" 55.5% versus 44.5% "}
{"type":"thought","data":"sits almost exactly "}
{"type":"thought","data":"on that fair line. This"}
{"type":"thought","data":" suggests the market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is efficiently priced"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and offers little edge."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nDust2's implied odds"}
{"type":"thought","data":" place Spirit at 52.6%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and MOUZ at 47.4%, "}
{"type":"thought","data":"confirming the market"}
{"type":"thought","data":" price sits near the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" fair line. The HLTV"}
{"type":"thought","data":" analytics page claiming"}
{"type":"thought","data":" MOUZ is the bookmaker"}
{"type":"thought","data":" favorite appears to"}
{"type":"thought","data":" be a parsing error "}
{"type":"thought","data":"or outdated snippet,"}
{"type":"thought","data":" so I will read the "}
{"type":"thought","data":"full page to verify."}
{"type":"thought","data":" I also need to examine"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the map pool matchup"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and the quality of "}
{"type":"thought","data":"Spirit's recent results."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe match has not "}
{"type":"thought","data":"yet started. The kickoff"}
{"type":"thought","data":" is scheduled for 14:00"}
{"type":"thought","data":" UTC on October 27, "}
{"type":"thought","data":"and the betting clock"}
{"type":"thought","data":" still shows roughly"}
{"type":"thought","data":" five minutes remaining."}
{"type":"thought","data":" I will finalize my "}
{"type":"thought","data":"decision and place the"}
{"type":"thought","data":" bet shortly."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nA personal probability"}
{"type":"thought","data":" estimate of 52-54% "}
{"type":"thought","data":"for Spirit and 46-48%"}
{"type":"thought","data":" for MOUZ is forming."}
{"type":"thought","data":" The recent head-to-head"}
{"type":"thought","data":" wins and dominant event"}
{"type":"thought","data":" form favor MOUZ, but"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the small sample size"}
{"type":"thought","data":" and Spirit's higher"}
{"type":"thought","data":" individual ceiling "}
{"type":"thought","data":"keep the split tight."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nMy prior CS bets favored"}
{"type":"thought","data":" the stronger team in"}
{"type":"thought","data":" each matchup. I will"}
{"type":"thought","data":" check Spirit's FURIA"}
{"type":"thought","data":" match and current rankings"}
{"type":"thought","data":" to judge who is actually"}
{"type":"thought","data":" better right now."}
{"type":"thought","data":"\n\nThe Spirit 55.5% price"}
{"type":"thought","data":" may be stale. It appears"}
{"type":"thought","data":" anchored to the HLTV"}
{"type":"thought","data":" #1 ranking, which historically"}
{"type":"thought","data":" lags behind current"}
